        Gauhati University Four Year Undergraduate Programme
                             (GU-FYUGP)

      NEP 2020 was implemented in all Higher Education Institutes (HEIs) of Assam from
      the Academic Session 2023-24 starting from August 2023. This starts the beginning of
      the Four Year Under-graduate Bachelor Degree Programme (FYUGP) in all colleges
      and universities under the state jurisdiction from August 2023. Accordingly, Darrang
      College is offering GU-FYUGP programme from the session- 2023-24.


      ACADEMIC BANK OF CREDIT (ABC): As per the New Education Policy- 2020,
      Government of India has introduced an ABC platform (Academic Bank of Credits).
      ABC is a national level facility to promote flexibility of curriculum frame work and
      provide academic mobility of students with appropriate credit transfer mechanism to
      choose their own learning path to attain a Degree / Diploma / PG Diploma, etc. working
      on the principle of multiple entry – multiple exit as well at anytime, anywhere and any
      level of learning. All prospective students who wish to take admission into the GU-
      FYUGP through Darrang College must be registered with the academic Bank of Credit
      (ABC) and must obtain the 12-digit ABC ID through Digi Locker platform. Students are
      encouraged to visit ABC website for all related information which are available along
      with video tutorial. Aadhar card is mandatory to login in ABC website.
      (www.abc.gov.in). As per the policy it is compulsory to the students to generate ABC
      IDs. Students are hereby informed to follow the following steps to get ABC IDs, they
      can generate ABC IDs through the following links.

      https://www.abc.gov.in
      www.digilocker.gov.in



      For more details about National Education Policy (NEP) 2020
      visit this LINK

                Admission Procedure: For GU-FYUGP
      1.   Admission will be conducted as per NEP–2020 for FYUGP under Gauhati
           University.
      2.   The candidates have to first register themselves with the Academic Bank of
           Credit (ABC) by visiting the website https://www.abc.gov.in/ and selecting
           Gauhati University.
      3.   The next step is to visit https://assamadmission.samarth.ac.in/ apply for
          admission in FYUGP under Gauhati University and select Darrang College
          as one of your preferred College.
      4. The different programmes are categorized as NEP-STREAM
          (BA/BSc/BCom) and NEP-DISCIPLINE (BCA/BSc Biotechnology).
      5. Fee structure and payment mode will be as per government notification.
      6. Reservation of seats as per government guidelines.
      7. Admission will be strictly on Merit basis.
      8. No claim of Admission shall be entertained after the date and time of
          Admission.
      9. Admission will be on offline mode basis.
      10. All original documents have to be produced for verification on the day of
          Admission.
      11. Only State and National level certificates will be entertained for the
          candidates’ claiming seats against Co-curricular category.
      12.  A candidate has to submit the following at the time of offline admission.
            (a) A photocopy of the mark sheet of the last qualifying examination.
            (b) Caste certificate /certificate for differently able/ Gap certificate (court
                affidavit only), wherever applicable with size.
            (c) A recent passport size photograph of the candidate
            (d) Signature of the candidate (1kb to 30k band 1.5cmX3.5cm)
            (e) For fee waiver, income certificate issued only from Circle officer will be
                considered.
      13. Hostel seats will be allotted strictly on merit basis and as per Govt.
          Reservation Rules after admission.

      Subjects like – Fine Arts, Music, Dance, Work Experience, Vocational subjects
      will not be considered for counting merit position.

      Candidates having more than three years study gap will not be eligible for
      admission.

                               RULES AND REGULATIONS

      College Uniform:

      College Uniform is compulsory. Students not in proper uniform are not allowed
      entry to the college. The uniform will be as follows:

      For Boys: Black pants (Formal only), sky blue shirt. For Girls: Spun Muga
      Mekhela and Off white Chadar with maroon border and Maroon Blouse / Off
      white Saree with Maroon Blouse / Off white Salwar: Off white Dupatta: Maroon
      Kameez (knee length).

      Maroon Sweater and Black shoes/ sandals are common to both boys and girls.

      Identity Card: Every Bonafide student will be issued College identity card after
      admission.
      Reservation: The College follows the Government Reservation rules.
      Cancellation of seats: Students found absent for a period of 10 days at a stretch
      after admission without intimation to the authority will forfeit their seats.
      Besides, a student may have to lose his/her seat in the manner mentioned in
      “General Rules” stated below:


                                        General Rules:

      Students admitted to this college must abide by all rules and regulations of the
      college. Violation of the rules, irregular attendance, misconduct in any form,
      adopting unfair means at the examinations and the likes will be treated as serious
      offences leading to suspension or even expulsion from the college. Ragging is
      strictly prohibited. Students found indulging in such activities will be expelled
      from the college. Further, no student is allowed to take-up any other full-time
      course or hold a service during his / her stay in the college. Organizations,
      societies etc. of the students of Darrang College, will function only under the
      guidance of the college authority. Only the organizations /societies recognized by
      the college authority will be permitted to use the facilities of the College premises.
      All the notices desired to be pasted or circulated must be countersigned by the
      Principal.

      DARRANG COLLEGE STUDY CENTRE OF KKHSOU

      Darang College is a renowned institution of higher education in Assam, located on the
      north bank of the Brahmaputra. Assam is also striving to keep pace with the world's
      education sector. The Krishna Kanta Handique State Open University, established in
      2006, has made an unprecedented contribution to the educational sector of Assam.
      Krishna Kanta Handique State Open University has provided many job opportunities to
      financially backward students who are unable to pursue higher education due to busy
      schedules and has made the dream of pursuing higher education come true for many.
      Darang College has realized the relevance of distance free education from 2022

             The State Open University has started a study center. Enrollment in

      COLLEGE LIBRARY
      Darrang College has a modern automated library in a separate building in its premises.
      The library has an impressive collection of books, Journals, Newspapers, Magazines, e-
      Journals, e-books, bibliographic databases etc.

      The newly constructed library with its open access system and spacious reading area
      provides and atmosphere conductive to the excitement of constructive mentality.
      Students are encouraged to become sagacious users of the library which is a welcome
      heaven for intellectual pursuits. Moreover, most of the departments of the college have
      an individual library called departmental library, which provides additional help to
      students and teachers in their academic pursuits. The library also provides access to e-
      resources to the teachers and students through UGC – INFLIBNET N – List
      programme.

      A well-equipped computerized library is an invaluable aid to the young scholars. The
      college has a state of art library building spreading across three floors. The library
      remains open from 10.00 am to 4.00 pm on all working days. A student will have to
      apply on a separate form supplied by the librarian for access to library books. Each
      student is allowed to borrow three books for TDC (Honours) / PG students and two
      books for others at a time.

      LIBRARY RULES

      ▪   Library cards are not transferable.
      ▪   Books are issued to students for a period of fifteen (15) days.
      ▪   An overdue charge of Rs.5/- only per day is levied if a book is kept beyond the due
          date.
      ▪   Books on loan with members can be recalled at any time without assigning any
          reason thereof. Borrowers must check the physical condition of the book before
          getting them issued. Otherwise, they will be held responsible for any damage or
          mutation notice at the time of return.
      ▪   Reference books marked restricted and bound volumes of periodicals and question
          papers are not issued.
      ▪   A fine of Rs. 50/- will be charged for reissue of a library card.
